A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same AT-DPT research and provide readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices. Relocated material can be matched, supporting a reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original bandit and Darkroom2 experiments in Tables 1–8, plus Miniworld training curves and additional analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: V2 retains original experimental results, revises the Darkroom2 scores, and reports additional Miniworld comparisons in Table 9.

M1.justification: The architecture, supervised objective, attacker training, and per-step context updates are retained. V2's test-phase Algorithm 2 matches v1's appendix Algorithm 3. Algorithm 1 changes 'REINFORCE' to 'RL', but the accompanying text still specifies REINFORCE.

E1.justification: Both versions cover multi-armed bandits, linear bandits, Darkroom2, and Miniworld. Miniworld already appears in v1 Figure 6 and Appendix C.1; v2 adds its task description and evaluation table without establishing a new task or domain.

E2.justification: V2 Table 9 adds PPO as a Miniworld comparator alongside AT-DPT and frozen DPT. Comparator membership in the retained bandit and Darkroom2 comparisons is unchanged.

E3.justification: The added Miniworld comparison specifies 100 episodes of PPO learning before evaluation in Table 9. Previously stated protocols for retained comparisons are unchanged; newly supplied Miniworld settings do not establish revisions to the earlier experiment.

E4.justification: The training curves, corruption-level comparisons, and budget-sensitivity analysis are retained. The Darkroom2 recovery case study moves from v1 Appendix C.3/Figure 8 to v2 Section 5.4/Figure 3. Table 9 adds benchmark comparisons, without a distinct new ablation or diagnostic analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and 95% confidence intervals calculated as 2×SEM over 10 replications. Table 9 follows this reporting practice. Revised interval values do not establish changed statistical procedures or increased run counts.

E6.justification: Tables 4 and 8 substantially revise Darkroom2 results under unchanged stated settings. At ε=0.4, frozen DPT's uniform-random-attack reward changes from 123.9±6.9 to 266.2±8.1, reversing its ranking; Q-learning against the NPG-targeted attacker changes from 112.5±5.0 to 215.4±7.6. Table 9 adds Miniworld results. Tables 1–3 and 5–7 remain numerically unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical setup, contamination model, attacker objective, Nash-equilibrium formulation, and Appendix A formulas are retained. No new or revised theorem, proof, or derivation appears.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions, and discussion retain the same claims about adversarial training, robustness against learned bandit attacks, and applicability to MDPs. The additional Miniworld evidence supports existing claims without redefining them.

C2.justification: The generalization interpretation, clean/random-attack tradeoff, oracle-action limitation, and proposed attack diversification remain unchanged. The recovery explanation is relocated. The added 'non-behavior-targeted' terminology restates the existing objective of reducing return without forcing a specific policy.

D1.justification: Appendix B.4 newly documents Miniworld's 25×25-pixel observations, four candidate goal boxes, 250-step episodes, attack budget of 5, and CleanRL implementation of PPO. Hardware and runtime disclosures are retained; the test-phase pseudocode is relocated rather than newly supplied.

R1.justification: V2 adds Hussenot et al. (2019) and Boloor et al. (2020) when distinguishing policy-forcing attacks, plus Chevalier-Boisvert et al. (2023) for Miniworld and Huang et al. (2022) for CleanRL. The broader related-work discussion and novelty positioning remain stable.

P1.justification: V2 makes local wording and cross-reference edits, integrates v1's test-phase appendix material into Section 5.2 and its recovery interpretation into Section 5.4, and adds a short Miniworld description. Most prose and the overall section sequence are retained.

P2.justification: V2 adds Table 9 and moves the existing Darkroom2 illustration into the main text. Figure 2 changes its legend from 'DPT' to 'AT-DPT' and its y-axis wording to 'Total Regret per Round'. Title, headings, running headers, and float placement are reformatted, while existing plot content and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: V2 addresses v1's limited Miniworld reporting by supplying comparative evaluation against PPO and explicit task and implementation details. Moving the test procedure and recovery example into the main text also improves accessibility. These are limited, useful gains; the substantial Darkroom2 score revisions remain unexplained and cannot be credited as verified corrections.
